title: Food-Loss Claims and Payments under Northgate Protect
content:
Northgate Protect pays for food lost when a covered refrigerator or freezer fails, on the tiers that carry a food-loss amount, and books each payment as the food-loss payment settlement of the food-loss claim it pays.

**Covered perils.** A claim is covered only for the perils the tier covers: mechanical and electrical failure from normal use, normal wear and power surge on every tier; accidental damage from handling and battery failure where the tier covers accidental damage and battery failure; food loss on a failed refrigerator or freezer where the tier's food-loss maximum is above zero, paid on a Standard-tier plan, and only on such a plan, as the food-loss payment, and on any other tier up to the tier's food-loss maximum.

Once booked, the claim shows its food-loss payment on the plan's ledger, and the plan's remaining limit of liability is lowered by the payment.

## Invocation: `pay_food_loss_claim_b4f587dd`

**Capability.** Books one food-loss payment settlement entry on the plan the claim belongs to, pointing back at the claim and at the covered order line, with the payment amount passed in, and lowers the plan's remaining limit of liability by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `pay_food_loss_claim_b4f587dd` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `claim_event_id` | The identifier (claim reference) of the food-loss claim being paid, as it appears on the plan's ledger |
| `amount_usd` | The food-loss payment, US dollars as a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places; any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt: "Food-loss payment booked on claim <claim_event_id> of plan <plan_id>: settlement <settlement_ref>, USD <amount>; remaining limit of liability now USD <remaining>." with a new settlement reference and two-decimal amounts. Receiving it means the food-loss payment was booked. An amount that is not positive is answered with "Error: amount_usd must be a positive amount in US dollars." and nothing is booked.
